scientific_integrity: A full general exterior-chain proof and integral homotopy argument accompany reproducible finite checks; computer checks are supplementary and no numerical experiment is presented as proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs as strictly one-dimensional simplicial complexes; tolerance t>=2; no general higher-dimensional input or clique-complex extension; no independent mathematical audit or exhaustive priority determination.
title: Integral sphere-wedge and component-module formula for graph tolerance complexes in every tolerance degree
